result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the promotional details text in the top banner has poor contrast and is hard to read. Items intentionally clipped by horizontal carousels or the bottom viewport are not reported as defects per the instructions.

issues.description: The promotional details text ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') inside the mint-green banner is very faint and has insufficient contrast against the background, making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the details text or adjust the banner background color so the text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
